proposed.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
proposed.text: Pietro and Wanda join the Avengers against Ultron in Sokovia, where Pietro dies shielding Clint from gunfire.
cases: ST-031 The Battle of Sokovia (Avengers: Age of Ultron)

changes.evidence: Age of Ultron plot: the twins side with the Avengers in Sokovia and 'Pietro dies when he shields Barton from gunfire'. The file jumps from At large straight to Deceased in WandaVision with no death record.

now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
now.text: Recorder Theel carries the passkey to Rocket's kill switch. He dies in the fall when Quill and Groot leap with him to Counter-Earth.

proposed.text: Recorder Theel carries the passkey to Rocket's kill switch. Quill and Groot leap with him off the Arête, and once Groot glides them down, Quill slams him into the ground on Counter-Earth, killing him.

changes.evidence: Theel does not die in the fall: Groot grows wings and glides them down, then Quill slams Theel against the ground, killing him, and cuts the code from his headpiece. Wikipedia: 'jump off the spaceship with Theel, whom they kill'.

proposed.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
proposed.text: Shalla-Bal returns to stop Johnny from sacrificing himself, then pushes Galactus into the portal herself, and it closes behind them both.
cases: ST-124 The Coming of Galactus (The Fantastic Four: First Steps)

changes.evidence: Film plot: 'Johnny attempts to sacrifice himself... but is stopped by Shalla-Bal. She pushes Galactus into the portal herself and it closes behind them.' Her turn against Galactus has no record; the file ends with her fleeing.

proposed.title: Thor: Ragnarok
proposed.text: Skurge turns on Hela's army to defend the fleeing Asgardians and dies holding them off on the Bifrost Bridge.

changes.evidence: Wikipedia plot: 'a repentant Skurge sacrifices himself to save the citizens'. Fandom: he comes out of hiding with his guns to fight off the Berserkers climbing onto the ship, then jumps out and dies. The file ends with him hiding, status At large.

now.title: The Defenders
now.text: In episode 7, Alexandra raises Elektra as the Black Sky to reach the treasure under Midland Circle.

proposed.text: In episode 3, Alexandra raises Elektra as the Black Sky to reach the treasure under Midland Circle.

changes.evidence: Alexandra is killed by Elektra in episode 6 ('Ashes, Ashes'), so this record can't be in episode 7, and it comes before the episode 6 record. Episode 3 ('Worst Behavior') shows the Hand resurrecting Elektra and Alexandra training the Black Sky, and Midland Circle is found as the Hand's front.

now.title: Daredevil S1
now.text: In episode 9, Hoffman kills his partner Blake on Fisk's orders, then flees for his life.

proposed.text: In episode 8, Hoffman kills his partner Blake on Fisk's orders, then flees for his life.

changes.evidence: Episode 8 ('Shadows in the Glass'): 'Fisk convinces Hoffman to kill Blake... Blake... dies.' Hoffman next appears in episode 13; he is not in episode 9. The Christian Blake file already puts this death in episode 8.

now.title: The Punisher S1
now.text: In episode 11, Wolf, tied to Rawlins's heroin smuggling, is killed by Frank at home.

proposed.text: In episode 2, Wolf, tied to Rawlins's heroin smuggling, is killed by Frank at home.

changes.evidence: Season 1 episode 2 ('Two Dead Men'): 'Castle tortures and kills Wolf'. By episode 4 Madani is already looking into Wolf's murder, so episode 11 is wrong.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 107, the Confederacy offers to protect Earth in return for Inhumans and gravitonium.

proposed.text: In episode 103, the Confederacy offers to protect Earth in return for Inhumans and gravitonium.

changes.evidence: The offer comes out in season 5 episode 15 (episode 103, 'Rise and Shine'): Hale 'informs Coulson that an alien alliance known as the Confederacy made contact with Hydra and offered to assist Earth during an impending invasion'. Episode 107 is the Remorath raid on the Lighthouse, not the offer.
